note: Rewritten from entry 474 'Ahmaditermes tianmuensis Gao, 1988' in Fauna Sinica, Insecta Vol. 17, Isoptera; the original is in Chinese; the book records soldiers and large and small workers, the alate is not described. The original literature citation (Ahmaditermes tianmuensis Gao, 1988, Sci. Tech. Term. 5(2): 9—15), figure 562 and the distribution records are not included. A few values in the soldier measurement table (e.g. head length including nasus 1.56—1.584, hind tibia length 1.08—1.105) have unusual precision; they are reproduced as printed in the original table. The copyright page was not visible in the OCR, so the citation year is left blank.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pyriform, rather wide, widest posteriorly, the nasus tubular and slightly upturned in lateral view, the apical teeth of the mandibles mostly indistinct, antennae mostly 13-segmented (occasionally 14); head length including the nasus 1.56—1.584 mm (mean 1.572 mm), head length excluding the nasus 0.984—1.008 mm, head width 0.87—0.95 mm; pronotum width 0.432—0.458 mm; hind tibia length 1.08—1.105 mm. Workers of two sizes, large and small, the antennae 14-segmented in both; large worker head nearly circular, head length to the tip of the labrum 1.20—1.35 mm, head width 1.00—1.08 mm; small worker head nearly oblate, antennal segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4 together.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, the frons slightly paler, nasus reddish brown and slightly paler at the base, antennae pale yellow, anterior part of the pronotum nearly concolorous with the head, mesonotum, metanotum, abdomen and legs brownish yellow. Head hairs sparse, the tip of the nasus with short hairs. Head pyriform, rather wide, widest posteriorly, the median posterior emargination visible; nasus tubular, slightly upturned in lateral view, the base of the nasus slightly raised, the vertex not very convex. Apical teeth of the mandibles mostly indistinct. Antennae mostly 13-segmented, occasionally 14; in the 13-segmented condition segment 4 shortest, segments 2 and 3 equal. Anterior part of the pronotum erect, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the middle of the posterior margin slightly arcuately concave. Abdomen olive-shaped. Measurements (means in parentheses): head length including nasus 1.56—1.584 (1.572) mm; head length excluding nasus 0.984—1.008 (0.989) mm; head width 0.87—0.95 (0.912) mm; pronotum width 0.432—0.458 (0.44) mm; hind tibia length 1.08—1.105 (1.09) mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head pale yellowish brown, antennae nearly concolorous with the head, abdomen and legs yellow. Head subcircular, head length to the tip of the labrum 1.20—1.35 mm (mean 1.26 mm), head width 1.00—1.08 mm (mean 1.035 mm), with a pale T-shaped cephalic suture; antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3. Small worker: head nearly oblate, body colour paler than in the large worker, chaetotaxy as in the large worker; head length to the tip of the labrum 1.11 and 1.14 mm, head width 0.95 and 0.96 mm; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segments 3 and 4 together. Distribution: Zhejiang (Tianmu Mountains).
